limits: Whether a private repository's per-PR analysis page is publicly readable is not established and this ticket does not establish it. The decline does not rest on it being public; it rests on nobody being able to say it is not.

Everything about the bot's behaviour comes from repowise's own documentation, read on 24 September 2026. None of it was verified against a running installation, because verifying it is the thing being declined.

The two pages that would normally carry the data-handling answers, /privacy and /security, both returned 404. The decision was taken without them, and if they appear later they may change the picture.

must_fix came back no at 0.51 against its 0.7 threshold on the second review, a coin flip. Four findings were raised and resolved, one of them a file committed without being read; a reader should not take 0.51 as agreement.

SEEN-098's criterion is now marked declined. Nothing re-examined whether the rest of SEEN-098's delivery assumed the bot would arrive; nothing appears to, because the bot is a hosted surface and everything the harness uses is local.
The review was a self-review, like every ticket in this epic. An independent pass over the harness is still owed.
